ownership_rule: The project owns this database; no application owns it or its table. The S-Story skeleton reaches it only through the one intermediary of the project database (qnc.module.db-broker), whose table module qnc.module.skeleton-db owns it.

rules.elements: Each element is a source clip (ton: a statement, picture and sound of its clip; off: the voice record of an OFF) with its own IN/OUT, A1/A2, A1 J/L and the pause or cut before it, in order. Elements are not story segments.
rules.record: Its own record, apart from the script (MA Audio sends to it) and the Story (it sends to the Story): the safe copy a broken Story is sent again from, all of it or a part.
